name: Jonathan (son of Abiathar)
title: Priest's son and messenger for David
summary: Jonathan, the son of priest Abiathar, served alongside Ahimaaz as a messenger for David during Absalom's rebellion. Later, he brought news to Adoniah that Solomon had been installed as king.

keyEvents.title: Messenger for David
keyEvents.description: Jonathan and Ahimaaz hid at En-Rogel to bring David a message during Absalom's rebellion.
